profileError.title: Profile unavailable
profileError.message: This profile could not be loaded.

profileStale.title: Profile not refreshed
profileStale.message: The last read failed; what is shown may be out of date.

refused.title: This profile is not accessible
refused.message: It does not exist, it is no longer published, or it is not open to you.

apercu.title: Preview: what network members see
apercu.message: Your personal controls are hidden during the preview. Nothing is changed.

identity.selfNote: This is what others see of you. Nothing else from your account is published.

toast.requestFailed: The invitation could not be sent.
toast.respondFailed: Your response could not be sent.
toast.muted: Posts from {{name}} no longer appear in your feed.
toast.unmuted: Posts from {{name}} are back in your feed.
toast.muteFailed: The mute could not be saved.

mute.label: Mute
mute.hint: Their posts leave your feed in this network. They are not told, and you can still write to each other.

unmute.label: Unmute their posts
unmute.hint: Their posts come back to your feed in this network.

block.label: Block @{{handle}}
block.hint: You will no longer see each other, in any network. The person is not told.

blockedByMe.title: You blocked @{{handle}}
blockedByMe.message: Their profile and posts stay closed to you, and yours to them, across all your ANTSIA networks. They were not told.

wall.errorMessage: The posts could not be loaded.
wall.emptySelf: You have not published anything yet.
wall.emptyOther: No post is open to you here.

facts.title: What the network shows of you
facts.imagesNote: The “Photo” and “Cover” controls below are the only way an image reaches your profile. Your display name is the one you choose: it is never taken from your sign-in account.

profilReseauSection.preview: Preview — as network members see it

error.title: Network profile unavailable
error.message: Your profile could not be loaded. Your existing settings are kept.

editor.title: Your network profile
editor.nameHint: The name you appear under. It is not taken from your account: you decide.
editor.nameRequired: Enter the name you want to appear under.
editor.handleHint: Your address on the network: it is how people find you and connect with you.
editor.headlineHint: One line to describe what you do.

unpublished.title: You cannot be found yet
unpublished.body: Your account name is never published on the network: it was collected to authenticate you, not to expose you. Publish a network profile to be found, receive connection requests and appear under your name.

retired.title: Your profile is withdrawn from the network
retired.body: You can no longer be found and your name is shown neutrally. Nothing has been deleted: publishing your profile again restores you.

withheld.avatarPending: Your photo is undergoing a security scan: it will appear in a few moments.
withheld.avatarBlocked: Your photo was blocked by the security scan. Choose another one.
withheld.coverPending: Your cover is undergoing a security scan: it will appear in a few moments.
withheld.coverBlocked: Your cover was blocked by the security scan. Choose another one.

toast.avatarPending: Photo saved: it will appear once its scan is complete.
toast.coverPending: Cover saved: it will appear once its scan is complete.
toast.avatarFailed: The photo could not be saved.
toast.coverFailed: The cover could not be saved.
toast.publishFailed: Publishing failed. This public handle may already be taken.
toast.nowOffline: Profile offline. Your connections and posts are intact.
toast.backOnline: You are visible on the network again.
toast.withdrawn: Profile unpublished. You can no longer be found; nothing has been deleted.

handleChoiceCard.needName: Enter your display name first: the suggestions are based on it.
handleChoiceCard.error: The suggestions could not be loaded. You can type your handle yourself.
handleChoiceCard.none: No form is available from this name. Type your handle yourself.

publish.title: You cannot be found yet
publish.body: Your profile is not published on the network. Publish it to be found, receive invitations and appear under your name.

accountNotCopied.title: Your account publishes nothing on your behalf
accountNotCopied.body: Your account name, your email address and your sign-in photo are never taken over onto the network. Your profile starts empty: everything it shows is what you put there.

publishedByChoice.title: Your profile exists only if you publish it
publishedByChoice.body: Your public handle, display name and headline are the ones you choose when publishing. Once published, your profile is visible to network members.

restByGesture.title: Everything else goes out only through an action
restByGesture.body: Photo, cover, posts, albums: each is added by an action of yours and removed the same way. A new photo or cover may be held back during its security scan before it appears.

offline.label: Go offline
offline.consequence: You appear neither in searches nor in suggestions, and no one can send you a new invitation or start following you.
offline.reversibility: Your connections and posts are intact, and coming back to the network restores you as you were.

withdraw.label: Withdraw from the network
withdraw.consequence: Your profile is unpublished: your name is no longer shown to other members and links to your page lead nowhere.
withdraw.reversibility: Nothing is deleted and your public handle remains yours — no one else can take it in the meantime.

mute.label: Mute a person
mute.consequence: Their posts leave your feed in this network. They are not notified and your connection stays in place.
mute.reversibility: The “Muted people” list on this page restores them in one click.

hide.label: Hide a post
hide.consequence: This post disappears from your feed in this network, for you only. Its author still sees it and can share it.
hide.reversibility: The “Hidden posts” list on this page restores it in one click.

block.label: Block a person
block.consequence: The link is cut both ways and in every network: no more messages, no more invitations, no more following each other, nothing of one reaches the other. Blocking is silent — the person is not told.
block.reversibility: The block can be lifted, but neither the broken connection nor the removed follows come back by themselves: you have to invite or follow again.
